Method of Attack: Hardcoded credentials allowing administrator-level access via PremiSys Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) Service endpoint
Weak encryption using Base64 encoded MD5 hashes for storing sensitive information
Card backups stored in password-protected ZIP archive with unlock key coded into the application
Default username and password pair protecting the database with no user-changeable password without vendor interaction
Impacted Systems: PremiSys IDentity identification and building access management system
Attack Vector: Accessing card backup files using embedded unlock key
